criminal-justice.quote:
Stolen Credit: DOJ prosecutes less than 1% of violent crime, less than 1% of homicides. 

Yet Republicans want to give Todd Blanche credit for years of reduced violent crime and homicide. 

Beats talking about his “fraud on the court” problem, I guess.

Latest on Reflecting Pool Debacle: 

The falsely-charged “vandal” has just filed an important motion in the case after the U.S. Attorney dismissed his felony charges “without prejudice” — meaning they could charge him again.

They alleged ethics violations by Pirro and her office, both in what she said in the press about the case and in the conduct of the case, as “bad faith” and “politically motivated.” That’s a harsh challenge, but well-founded.

The record of misconduct in this case clearly justifies further inquiry. This is no “Hail Mary.” Pirro is now caught between two fires: the fire of Trump’s incontinent rage, and the fire of judicial proceedings into professional misconduct.
